items.name: Network Video Recorder Pro (UNVR-Pro)

items.name: Cloud Gateway Ultra (UCG-Ultra)

items.name: SmartPower PDU Pro (USP-PDU-Pro)
items.note: Page lists 442.4 x 87.4 x 106 mm without axis labels, so height vs depth (87.4 / 106) is ambiguous and rack units are not stated. 3.5 kg without mount (3.7 kg with). Page's 1875 W is the outlet load capacity at 125 V, not the device's own draw, so powerW left null.

items.name: CRS326-24G-2S+RM
items.note: MikroTik gives 443 x 144 x 44 mm; 443 may include the fixed ears (body likely ~440). Weight not listed on the page.

items.name: CRS305-1G-4S+IN
items.note: Desktop. 18 W max (10 W without attachments). Weight not listed.

items.name: RB5009UG+S+IN
items.note: Desktop. 25 W max (14 W without attachments). Weight not listed. Rack option: K-79 kit mounts up to four RB5009 in 1U of a 19in rack (retailers say 19in). I found no official 10in rack kit, so a 10in mount would be third-party/3D-printed.

items.name: GS308 8-port Gigabit (v3)
items.note: Desktop. Current v3 hardware; older v1/v2 were 158 x 102 x 26 mm, ~0.4-0.47 kg, 3.8 W.

items.name: TL-SG108 8-port Gigabit
items.note: Desktop. Weight not on page. Other TP-Link regional pages list 2.77 W max depending on hardware version.

items.name: PowerEdge R640
items.note: Width Xb 434 (482 with ears). Depth = Za without bezel 22.0 + Zc ear-to-PSU-handle 772.67 (4x3.5/10x2.5 chassis); to rear wall it is 755.8; 8x2.5 chassis is ~51 mm shorter. Weight max with all drives (Dell chassis-weight page). powerW = largest PSU (1600 W, high line only; 2 PSUs redundant), from Dell PSU spec page via search, not opened.

items.name: PowerEdge R740
items.note: Depth = Za 22.0 (no bezel) + Zc 715.5 to PSU handle; matches Dell spec sheet 737.5 mm. Weight 28.6 kg max for 3.5in drive systems (26.3 kg for 2.5in), from Dell manual via search. powerW = largest PSU 2400 W (high line), from Dell PSU spec page via search, not opened.

items.name: PowerEdge R750
items.note: Depth = Za 22.0 (no bezel) + Zc 736.29 ear-to-PSU-handle (758.3 matches resellers). Weight 35.3 kg max (12x3.5in), from Dell chassis-weight page via search. PSU max not verified (likely up to 2400 W), so powerW null.

items.name: PowerEdge R760
items.note: Dell page: 86.8 H x 482 W (with ears) x 758.29 D without bezel (772.13 with). Body width 434 from the R760 service manual (Xb). 36.1 kg max. powerW = largest listed PSU 3200 W (277 VAC); largest at 200-240 V is 2800 W, at 100-240 V 2400 W.

items.name: ProLiant DL360 Gen10 (SFF)
items.note: From HPE QuickSpecs/datasheet figures quoted in search results (4.29 x 43.46 x 70.7 cm SFF; LFF depth 74.98 cm; 13.04-16.27 kg SFF). I could not open the QuickSpecs page myself. PSU options (Flex Slot up to 1600 W) not verified, so powerW null.

items.name: ProLiant DL380 Gen10 (8 SFF)
items.note: HPE physical specs as quoted in search results: H 8.73 cm, W 44.54 cm, D 67.94 cm SFF / 73.02 cm LFF; max 19.5 kg (8 SFF) / 24.5 kg (12 LFF). The page did not render for me. powerW null (PSU options not verified).

items.name: SC826BE16-R920LPB (CSE-826, 2U 12-bay)
items.note: Weight is gross (shipping) weight; Supermicro gives no net weight. powerW = PSU rating (920 W redundant Platinum). Other CSE-826 SKUs share the 437 x 89 x 647 body.

items.name: SC813MFTQC-505CB (CSE-813M, short-depth 1U)
items.note: Weight is gross weight. powerW = PSU rating (500 W Platinum).

items.name: RSV-L4500U 4U 15-bay chassis
items.note: Newegg (reseller) figures via search: 427 x 178 x 635 mm, 14.1 kg; the Rosewill manual says 14.5 kg net. Newegg blocked my direct fetch. No PSU included, so powerW null.

items.name: CX2137b short-depth 2U (13in deep)
items.note: Picked over CX2151x (Sliger page for that one gives 15in depth, no other numbers). Sliger only states 2U and 13in (330 mm) depth; ATX board, FlexATX PSU. Width, height, weight not published, so null.

items.name: Smart-UPS SMT1500RM2U
items.note: se.com page did not show physical specs to me. Numbers from Schneider datasheets for the SMT1500RM2UC variant as quoted in search (8.6 x 43.2 x 47.7 cm, 26.5 kg); some sources say 28.6 kg. powerW = output capacity 1000 W, not the UPS's own draw.

items.name: OR1500LCDRM1U Smart App LCD
items.note: CyberPower page blocked my fetch (HTTP 405); numbers are the official page's 43.31 x 4.45 x 38.86 cm, 14.97 kg as quoted in search results. Some resellers list 15.6in depth. powerW = output capacity.

items.name: CP1500PFCRM2U PFC Sinewave
items.note: Official page blocked (HTTP 405); figures 43.18 x 8.64 x 26.67 cm, 12.16 kg from spec-sheet text in search results. powerW = output capacity 1000 W.

items.name: RS-1215 1U 12-outlet power strip
items.note: Eaton page is region-blocked for me. Search results: 1.75 x 17.5 x 4.5 in (Tripp page reportedly says 4.0 in depth), 2.09 kg; 19in with flanges. It is passive (15 A / 1800 W load capacity, not verified), so powerW null.

items.name: DIGITUS DN-95418 10in socket strip, 4-way CEE 7/5, 1U
items.note: Assmann shop blocked my fetch (403). Datasheet text quoted in search: 254 mm (10in) x 45 (1U) x 45 mm; 254 mm is the full 10in width including mounting flanges. Sockets angled 45 deg. Weight not found. Passive strip, powerW null.

racks.name: RackMate T0 4U
racks.note: DeskPi wiki figures as quoted in search (wiki URL 404'd for me): external 280 x 200 x 274 mm (W x D x H), internal 222 x 200 x 241, 200 mm max install depth. Slightly taller than 4U for a fan plate.

racks.name: RackMate T1 8U
racks.note: Sources disagree: 406 H x 280 x 200 (one), 281 x 200 x 451 with handles (another). Depth 200 mm is consistent.

racks.name: RackMate T2 12U
racks.note: 281 W x 260 D x 596 H mm (629 with handle), 212 mm between rails, per Technobezz/comparison tables in search. One DeskPi blog said 16in deep, which conflicts.

racks.name: RackMate T1 Plus 8U (260 mm deep)
racks.note: Exists. DeskPi says it suits 260 mm deep NAS units; comparison table: 281 x 260 x 418 mm (451 with handles). DeskPi page rate-limited my fetch.

racks.name: DIGITUS DN-10-06U 10in 6U wall cabinet
racks.note: Assmann/Conrad datasheets via search: 330 H x 312 W x 300 D mm (a 400 mm deep -4 variant exists). Max equipment depth ~260 mm per Conrad, 240 mm per another Assmann listing. Enclosed wall cabinet with glass door. Datasheet PDF not readable by my tools.

racks.name: DIGITUS DN-10-09U 10in 9U wall cabinet
racks.note: Assmann datasheet via search: 464 x 312 x 300 mm (H x W x D), grey RAL 7035. Usable depth ~260 mm (Conrad) or 240 mm (black variant); the sourceUrl PDF may be the 6U or 9U sheet, both found in the same search.

racks.name: Tecmojo 9U wall-mount cabinet
racks.note: Newegg listing via search: 19.02 H x 21.65 W x 17.72 D in, max mounting depth 14.2 in (~360 mm). Enclosed wall cabinet. Not from a manufacturer datasheet.

racks.name: NavePoint 12U 4-post open frame rack
racks.note: Newegg listings via search: 27 H x 20.5 W in, adjustable depth 22-40 in (559-1016 mm), casters included. Outer depth follows the adjustment, so outerMm.d null; depthMm is the maximum.

racks.name: 4POSTRACK12U 12U open frame
racks.note: StarTech blocked my fetch (403). Resellers: mounting depth 22-40 in (559-1016 mm); outer 599 W x 637.5 H (710 with casters) x 662.9 D at minimum depth; casters and levelers included; 544 kg static.

racks.name: 4POSTRACK25U 25U open frame
racks.note: Only the 22-40 in mounting depth and casters were found (one listing says 23-41 in). Outer dimensions not found; 25U is about 1111 mm of rail space (25 x 44.45), not a measured outer height.

racks.name: 4POSTRACK42 42U open frame
racks.note: StarTech's 42U model is named 4POSTRACK42 (no U). Distributor figures: 604 W x 2040 H x 1048 D, mounting depth 560-1017 mm, 38.5 kg, casters (360 kg rolling / 600 kg static). Another source says 1970 H x 1000 D.

racks.name: NetShelter SX 42U 600 x 1070 (AR3100)
racks.note: Outer 1991 H x 600 W x 1070 D mm confirmed on the se.com product title; weight ~125 kg and max mounting depth 915 mm from resellers; casters from general product knowledge, not seen on the page. Superseded by AR3100B2.

racks.name: UniFi Rack 42U 800 mm, glass door (UACC-Rack-42U-800-G)
racks.note: Mounting depth 607.2 mm default, adjustable to 682.2 mm. Height 2050 with casters, 1966 without. 92.4 kg. 1000 mm deep variants exist (UACC-Rack-42U-1000-G/P: 600 x 1000 x 2050). UniFi also has a 12U wall rack (uacc-rack-12u-wall-450-p) and the Toolless Mini Rack.

racks.name: UniFi Toolless Mini Rack 6U (U-Rack-6U-TL)
racks.note: Extra entry. Page lists 519 x 460 x 485 mm with handle and casters (351 without) but no axis labels, so W/D are ambiguous (485/351 is height). 10.3 kg, lockable casters, stackable to 12U. Mounting depth not stated.
